description: Over the past several years, Mayor Nicholson has made strategic investments to improve Gardner Public Schools, keeping more students in our district, attracting new students, and enhancing educational opportunities. These achievements would not be possible without our dedicated educators, staff, and community members. By continuing to invest in our schools, we are ensuring that Gardner remains a place where students thrive, achieve, and build bright futures.
title: Public Schools | Mike Nicholson | Mayor of Gardner
